matches.quote: The microscopic attributions to in-band boundary states, hinge currents and "boundary–bulk interplay" are asserted rather than demonstrated, and some of the cited evidence is generic.
Inside the axion gap, the simulated resistance diverges... Yet Fig. 4f,g plots finite, near-linearly varying V^2ω across the same gap.
The attribution of V_xx,S to quantum-metric bulk transport "consistent with MnBi₂Te₄" has further problems: - It is unjustified without independent evidence... V_xx,S is also not negligible.
"In-band boundary states buried in the metallic surface states" and "hinge currents" are invoked mainly because |V^2ω| is larger in the slightly doped than in the highly doped regime.
There is no n_e–V_g mapping and no comparison of magnitudes, line shapes or line widths, nor of QAH-to-axion ratios.
Because the model imposes exact C₂z and omits warping, it cannot address V_xx,S... Add C₃v warping terms to predict V_xx,S
There is no n_e–V_g mapping and no comparison of magnitudes, line shapes or line widths, nor of QAH-to-axion ratios.
At (V_g − V_g⁰) = −15 V, V_yx(0.25 T) ≈ −70.8 µV versus V_xx,A ≈ −36.3 µV. Fig. 2f shows a clear mismatch in the QAH branch.
Exchange parameters; M_t = ±1.2, M_b = ±0.6 vs m₀ = 0.1; Not connected to the measured gaps... Calibrate parameters to the measured exchange gaps.
Any C₂z-respecting nonlinear mechanism therefore yields V_1 = V_4, V_2 = V_5, V_3 = V_6, i.e. V^2ω_xx,L = −V^2ω_xx,R = −V^2ω_yx... confirms device symmetry, not boundary dominance.

Several phrases are not formulated as falsifiable predictions and lack a model of how bulk carriers enable the boundary nonlinearity: "requires assistance from bulk carriers," ... "boundary–bulk interplay"

notes: C15 is marked partly because P13 notes the missing comparison of QAH-to-axion ratios between simulation and experiment without citing the specific ~20x vs ~5x numbers. C21 is marked partly because P4 singles out the same (Vg-Vg0) = -15 V panels (Fig. 2a,f) and the mismatch in the low-field QAH branch as outliers requiring discussion. C23 is marked partly because P13 questions why Fig. 4f,g (axion) varies linearly across the exchange gap where transmissions vanish, contrasting with the QAH gap.
